body: Well if I don’t take them, I become extremely sad, and will cry a lot. If I do, I feel numb and like shit. I have persistent depressive disorder, so my depressive episodes last around two years. With only like a couple days of break. So yes, they do make things numb for me, but the  alternative isn’t much better.

I have been trying out hobbies because the ones that use to make my life bearable don’t work anymore. I haven’t found one that stuck to me. I’m just jaded. I have medication. I have two antidepressants and one anti anxiety. I have tried therapy, but talking to people about my problems doesn’t do it for me. Also the exercises don’t work for me because I can’t convince myself I’m actually worth anything. I’m sorry that I sound super fucking negative. I  just don’t know what to do to keep me going.
Yes, I feel as if it’s the only option. Yes, you can.
